intro.uz: Jasur oilasi haqida yozadi. Oʻqishdan oldin: sizning oilangizda necha kishi bor?

paragraphs.en: My name is Jasur. There are six people in my family: my father, my mother, my grandmother, my two sisters and me.
paragraphs.uz: Mening ismim Jasur. Oilamizda olti kishi bor: otam, onam, buvim, opam, singlim va men.

paragraphs.en: My father is a driver. He drives a bus in Tashkent. My mother is a nurse. She works at a hospital. My grandmother doesn't work. She cooks very good plov!
paragraphs.uz: Otam haydovchi. U Toshkentda avtobus haydaydi. Onam hamshira. U kasalxonada ishlaydi. Buvim ishlamaydi. U juda mazali palov pishiradi!

paragraphs.en: My sisters are Madina and Shahzoda. Madina is twenty. She is a student at university. Shahzoda is eight. She is very funny. We have a cat. Its name is Momiq.
paragraphs.uz: Opamning ismi Madina, singlimniki — Shahzoda. Madina yigirma yoshda. U universitet talabasi. Shahzoda sakkiz yoshda. U juda kulgili. Bizning mushugimiz bor. Uning ismi Momiq.

grammar.example: There are six people in my family.

questions.statement: There are five people in Jasur's family.

explain.uz: Olti kishi: «There are six people in my family».
Onasi hamshira: «She works at a hospital.»

questions.statement: His grandmother works at a hospital.

explain.uz: «Its name is Momiq.» — its = uning (hayvon haqida).
